title: ExecutionFrictionXrayInput
description: Input for execution friction analysis of a meeting transcript. Supports two modes: transcript-only (broad friction scan) or transcript + context (targeted analysis with team context, focus area, and participant directory). All optional fields improve analysis quality when provided.

transcript.description: Full meeting transcript text. Must include enough content for meaningful friction analysis (minimum 100 characters). Speaker-attributed transcripts produce higher-confidence output.

meeting_title.description: Title or subject of the meeting. Helps contextualize friction points. Example: 'APAC Expansion Planning — Week 12'.

meeting_datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime of when the meeting occurred. Used to anchor timeline-based friction analysis.

team_context.description: Background on the team, project, or organization. Improves friction detection by grounding analysis in real constraints. Example: 'Series B startup, 60-person eng org, shipping v2 platform migration while maintaining v1 SLAs.'

focus_area.description: Specific execution concern to prioritize in the analysis. When provided, friction hotspots related to this area are weighted higher. Examples: 'launch readiness', 'cross-team handoff', 'resourcing constraints'.

urgency_level.description: How time-sensitive the execution context is. 'critical' = imminent deadline or launch, tightest scrutiny. 'low' = exploratory or long-horizon. Adjusts severity weighting.

analysis_depth.description: Controls thoroughness of analysis. 'quick' = top friction points only. 'standard' = balanced coverage. 'deep' = exhaustive analysis with more hotspots and granular evidence.

participant_directory.description: Known participants to improve owner attribution and cross-team friction detection.

name.description: Full name of the participant as they appear in the transcript.

role.description: Job title or organizational role. Example: 'VP Engineering', 'Product Lead'.

team.description: Team, department, or business unit. Example: 'Platform', 'Product', 'Finance'.

key_questions.description: Specific execution questions the analysis should address. Each should be a concrete concern. Example items: 'Is the launch timeline realistic given current dependencies?', 'Who owns the cross-team handoff for payments integration?'
